versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Launches the Logo SVG Generator skill to create production-ready SVG logos from product briefs, following Simple Icons design standards.
- Implements an iterative workflow: generate, visually review with a vision-capable LLM, optimize, and finalize.
- Supports multi-size (16–512px) and color variants, including a Simple-Icons-compatible 24×24 master SVG.
- Automatically collects key product information (name, purpose, style, color) and infers defaults where possible.
- Enforces single-path SVG output with strict design rule validation; provides feedback loop for fixes.
- Explicitly requires vision-LLM for logo review; offers opt-in structural-only checks when unavailable.
